subs.text: His session planner — bookings and the working week, inside his own platform.
Clients see free slots and book direct — assessments or sessions, no back-and-forth.
New clients request a session; his cancellation policy is clear upfront.
His view shows requests and client details — approve, or add sessions agreed by phone.
One diary, two views. Client names stay private on the public calendar.
Group classes stand out — spaces left, highlights under his control.
Set his hours, add buffers, block holidays — the diary runs itself.
Time away blocks new bookings and flags his return date.
Sessions export straight to his phone calendar.
Less organising, more coaching. The Desk pulls the business side together.
